segments.t: 图片 ICN & Flickr （一切权利归原作者 \ 转载请注明出处） ‘Fred Ives' 粉黛 ‘Fred Ives Variegated’ 粉黛锦 ‘Fred Ives Cristate’ 粉黛缀化 Created by Albert Baynes of Shipley, Yorkshire, UK. 由英国约克郡希普利地区的Albert Baynes培育成功 Parentage: Graptopetalum paraguayense x Echeveria gibbiflora hort. 亲本：风车草属胧月x 拟石莲属粉彩莲某园艺种 (译著：即 xGraptoveria 风车石莲) Synonyms \ 异名: Graptopetalum ivesii hort., Echeveria ivesii hort., Graptoveria ivesii hort., Echeveria gibbiflora hort. non DC, Echeveria 'Spring Morning', xGraptoveria 'Spring Morning'. First published by J. C. Van Keppel in Succulenta 58 (10) : 251-253,1979 and named for Fred Ives of Shipley, Yorkshire. 1979年首次出现在Van Keppel出版的《Succulenta 58》上，命名以纪念约克郡希普利地区一位叫Fred Ives的人物。 Description: “Caulescent, with a few-leaved, short rosette at the top; stem to 3 cm in diameter, green, flushed blue-grey, later brown and with pronounced leaf scars; rosette 30-40 cm in diameter; leaves glabrous, obovate-oblanceolate, +- 15 cm long, +- 6 cm wide in the upper half, 0.4 cm thick, often with an oblique mucro; upperside concave, backside convex, faintly keeled, tip curved down; colour green, flushed strongly bluish, in full sun turning to pinkish; inflorescence racemose with many long cincinnate axes, each with 5 – 15 yellowish flowers; flower stalks with many large bracts, which stay till after flowering; sepals long, unequal in size.” (Van Keppel in Nat. Cact. & Succ. J., Vol. 36/1, 1981 ) 描述：“有茎品种；莲座叶片疏落，着生于茎顶部；茎干直径至3厘米，绿杂蓝灰，之后棕变，遍布叶根残印；莲座直径30~40厘米；叶片无毛，倒卵披针形，约15厘米长，远端约6厘米宽，0.4厘米厚，常具斜短叶尖；叶上表面凹，背面凸，依稀龙骨痕迹，行至叶尖转而下；叶片基色绿，染醒目偏蓝光泽，全日照即转粉红；总状花序，抽生若干倒蝎尾花轴，每分支5 ​~15朵花，色黄；花茎着生大型苞片多个，花期后仍伫留；萼片长，大小不均。” (Van Keppel in Nat. Cact. & Succ. J., Vol. 36/1, 1981 ) Albert Baynes had indicated that the Echeveria-parent was E. gibbiflora. Van Keppel disagreed, because he knew that E. gibbiflora was not in cultivation in the UK at that time, but he also thought that a plant of the gibbiflora-complex was involved in this crossing. 培育者Albert Baynes表示，亲本之一为粉彩莲。Van Keppel持反对，因当时粉彩莲未在英国引种；但他也认为粉彩莲系的某交配种为其血亲。
